REVIEW_DECISION: REJECT
RISK_CLASS: high-impact
SUMMARY: Contract-impact classification is bypassable for authority-bearing files not present in the validator’s hard-coded path list.
FINDING: critical|scripts/factory-ng-provenance-validate.py|FACTORY_CONTRACT_PATHS/FILES omit scripts/map-pipeline-apply.py even though the baseline names it as the harness patch-application path|A change to patch scope or application authority can be labeled refactor/none and accepted without required Sol and Opus governance.
REQUIRED_CHANGE: Add all authority-bearing implementation paths to a governed manifest and require patch-aware classification that rejects any unclassified change affecting acceptance, patch application, gates, integration, or deployment authority; add an evasion fixture for map-pipeline-apply.py.
COUNTEREXAMPLE: Reuse the valid refactor provenance shape with changed_paths=["scripts/map-pipeline-apply.py"] while the patch permits arbitrary output paths; the relationship validator derives no contract area and accepts the Qwen-reviewed refactor classification.
